Emma (CS): Hey team — heads up on Zenport onboarding. Their search-summarization workload is spiking p95 latency and we have a renewal check in 6w. Thinking proactive optimizations: compact-model swap + int8 canary + split routing with hosted fallback. Want to align before I talk to the customer tomorrow.
Marta (SE): +1. Can we do a small canary: 5% traffic to compact-llm-v2 quantized int8, 95% to baseline for 48h. Warm KV cache first. :thumbsup:
perfbot: Zenport metrics (last 24h): p50=120ms, p95=410ms, requests/s=18, cost/1k_tokens=$2.10
Aj (Applied ML): Int8 is low-risk for distillation-friendly models. We should run a 2000-sample eval set from their production prompts — check semantic-bert score + prompt-level fuzzing. Target: <1.5% negative delta in quality. If int8 looks clean, we can test int4 in a separate window but that's higher risk.
Leo (SRE): Routing + autoscale note: set canary split via routing policy + add a 30s cooldown for autoscaler to avoid oscillation during the ramp. Also add a fallback policy: if p95_canary > 350ms OR error_rate > 0.5% for 10m, shift canary back to baseline.
Marta (SE): Proposed canary config snippet (example):
```
rollout:
  name: zenport-compact-int8-canary
  steps:
    - traffic: 5%
      duration: 48h
    - traffic: 25%
      duration: 24h
    - traffic: 100%
      duration: 1h
fallback: 
  thresholds:
    - metric: p95
      operator: '>'
      value: 350ms
      window: 10m
    - metric: errors
      operator: '>'
      value: 0.5%
      window: 10m
kv_warmup: true
cache_warmup_samples: 500
```
Marta (SE): Also will add a dataplane label so we can track cost per customer and attribute token spend during canary.
Nina (CSM): Renewal note — customer execs are sensitive to latency regressions. If p95 stays >350ms after tuning, flag as risk and I'll start a renewal playbook. Can we also prepare a 30-min enablement demo focused on their top 3 prompt patterns?
Emma (CS): I'll schedule the enablement session for next Wed and confirm the eval set with Zenport. Can we target starting the canary on Friday morning (US-PDT)?
Aj (Applied ML): I'll assemble the 2k eval set and run int8 sims overnight. Will post delta table here. Quick checklist: seed deterministic runs, include adversarial prompts, record hallucination buckets.
Leo (SRE): On my end I'll provision a dedicated canary pool (2x instances) and wire the fallback policy. Also will add tracing hooks to capture token-level latency.
perfbot: Canary readiness check: infra_quota=OK, model_catalog(compact-llm-v2)=available, recent-deploys=0
Marta (SE): Suggest adding a temporary cost cap for canary (e.g., $300/day) to avoid surprises if prefix caching doesn't hit.
Emma (CS): Sounds good. Marta/Leo/Aj — please post final canary config & eval summary by Thu EOD so I can confirm with customer before Friday. Nina — I'll add the renewal watch to the playbook.
Nina (CSM): Added renewal_watch tag and created feedback doc link: https://redwood.internal/zenport-feedback (please paste bulleted outcomes after canary).
Aj (Applied ML): Will share results here. If int8 passes, propose automated rollback policy be set to 'auto-fallback' for the first 72h after 100% cutover.
Emma (CS): Thanks team. Quick note for the runbook: include the exact roll-forward steps and an owner for each stage. I'll be the customer owner.
Marta (SE): I'll own rollout ops. Leo owns infra. Aj owns eval/quality sign-off.
Leo (SRE): Acknowledge. Will also add an alert for rollback reasons to the #incidents channel.
Emma (CS): Great — closing loop. I'll update Zenport and confirm the slot. :white_check_mark:
